**Richard Trenton Chase** (May 23, 1950 – December 26, 1980) was an American serial killer, cannibal and necrophile who killed six people in Sacramento, California, between December 1977 and January 1978.
He was nicknamed the **Vampire of Sacramento** because he drank his victims' blood and cannibalized their remains.
